clusters.name: memory-files-move
clusters.executionModeRationale: Pure file additions under .agents/memory/. No overlap with US-002 or US-003 surfaces. Can run independently in phase 1.

clusters.name: auto-load-wiring
clusters.executionModeRationale: Edits root-level guidance files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, docs/fork-notes.md). Depends on US-001 so the TOC entries point at files that actually exist.

clusters.name: user-dir-cleanup
clusters.executionModeRationale: Touches an out-of-tree user-dir path with a Windows junction. Must run after US-001/US-002 so the migrated content is verifiable before the original is removed. Independently deferrable per the operator's request.
